sendMessageToExistingChat.name: sendMessageToExistingChat
sendMessageToExistingChat.description: Sends a text message in a chat identified by chat_id

chat_id.description: Select the chat to send the message to

text.description: The text content of the message to be sent.

file.description: Optional file to send with the message.

label.description: Optional label to categorize or tag the message.

attachment_template_id.description: Optional ID of the attachment template to use for the message.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a text message into an existing TimelinesAI WhatsApp chat identified by its numeric chat_id, optionally attaching an uploaded file and a label. Use to reply within a conversation you already have the chat_id for; use Send Message to New Chat instead when starting a conversation by phone or JID. Not idempotent: each call posts a new message.

sendUploadedFileToExistingChat.name: sendUploadedFileToExistingChat
sendUploadedFileToExistingChat.displayName: Send Uploaded File to Existing Chat
sendUploadedFileToExistingChat.description: Send a file (media/attachment) to a chat, with metadata like file name, via existing chat.

chat_id.description: Select the chat to send the message to

aiMetadata.description: Sends an already-uploaded file, selected by its file uid, as an attachment into an existing TimelinesAI WhatsApp chat identified by its numeric chat_id. Use when the file is already uploaded (e.g. found via Find Uploaded File); use Send File to Existing Chat to upload and send raw file data in one step. Not idempotent: each call posts a new message.

sendFileToExistingChat.name: sendFileToExistingChat
sendFileToExistingChat.description: Similar to above: send a file attachment to a chat using URL or file input and name.

chat_id.description: Select the chat to send the message to

file.description: The file to be sent in the chat.

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a file and sends it as an attachment into an existing TimelinesAI WhatsApp chat identified by its numeric chat_id. Use when you have raw file data to deliver into a known chat. Not idempotent: each call uploads the file and posts a new message.

sendMessageToNewChat.name: sendMessageToNewChat
sendMessageToNewChat.description: Create a new chat (new conversation) by specifying the WhatsApp account, phone number, and message.

contactType.description: Select the type of contact identifier

contact.description: Select the contact identifier based on the chosen contact type

text.description: The text message to be sent in the chat.

file.description: The file to be sent in the chat.

label.description: An optional label to categorize the chat.

chat_name.description: An optional name for the chat (useful for group chats).

attachment_template_id.description: Optional ID of a predefined attachment template to use when sending files.

aiMetadata.description: Starts a new TimelinesAI WhatsApp conversation by addressing a contact either by phone number or by WhatsApp JID (selected via Contact Type), then sending an initial text and/or file. Use to message someone you do not yet have a chat_id for; use Send Message to Existing Chat when you already have the chat_id. Not idempotent: each call sends a message and may create a new chat.

closeChat.name: closeChat
closeChat.description: Programmatically mark a chat as closed by its chat_id.

chat_id.description: Select the chat to send the message to

aiMetadata.description: Marks a TimelinesAI WhatsApp chat as closed, identified by its numeric chat_id. Use to resolve or archive a conversation once handling is done. Idempotent: closing an already-closed chat sets the same end state with no additional effect.

findChat.name: findChat
findChat.description: Look up a chat by parameters such as chat_id, phone, name, etc.

label.description: Filter by labels assigned to the chat

group.description: Filter by whether the chat is a group chat

responsible.description: Filter by the user responsible for the chat (email)

name.description: Filter by the name of the chat

read.description: Filter by whether the chat is marked as read

closed.description: Filter by whether the chat is closed

chatgpt_autoresponse_enabled.description: Filter by whether ChatGPT autoresponse is enabled for the chat

created_after.description: Filter chats created after this date

created_before.description: Filter chats created before this date

aiMetadata.description: Searches TimelinesAI WhatsApp chats, optionally filtered by labels, WhatsApp account, name, group/read/closed/autoresponse flags, responsible user, and creation date range; with no filters supplied it returns all chats (paginated). Use to find a chat or its chat_id before sending or closing. Read-only and idempotent.

findMessage.name: findMessage
findMessage.description: Lookup a message by its WhatsApp message ID.

message_uid.description: The unique identifier of the message to find.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single TimelinesAI WhatsApp message by its message UID. Use to fetch the full content and metadata of a known message. Requires the exact message_uid. Read-only and idempotent.

findUploadedFile.name: findUploadedFile
findUploadedFile.description: Locate an uploaded file by filename or identifier.

filename.description: The name of the uploaded file to search for.

aiMetadata.description: Lists files previously uploaded to TimelinesAI, optionally filtered by filename; with no filename it returns all uploaded files. Use to find a file and its uid before attaching it to a chat message. Read-only and idempotent.

findMessageStatus.name: findMessageStatus
findMessageStatus.description: Lookup a message’s delivery status by message ID.

message_uid.description: The unique identifier of the message to look up.

aiMetadata.description: Returns the delivery status of a TimelinesAI WhatsApp message identified by its message UID. Use to check whether a previously sent message was delivered or read. Requires the exact message_uid. Read-only and idempotent.

findWhatsappAccount.name: findWhatsappAccount
findWhatsappAccount.description: Search for a WhatsApp account (by phone or ID).

id.description: The unique identifier of the WhatsApp account to search for.

phone.description: The phone number associated with the WhatsApp account to search for.

aiMetadata.description: Lists the WhatsApp accounts connected to TimelinesAI, optionally narrowed by account ID and/or phone number; with neither supplied it returns all accounts. Use to resolve a whatsapp_account_id before sending a message from a specific number. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

chatClosed.name: chatClosed
chatClosed.description: Fires when a chat is closed.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a TimelinesAI WhatsApp chat is marked closed (resolved/archived). Polls for chats in the closed state and emits each newly closed conversation.

newOutgoingChat.name: newOutgoingChat
newOutgoingChat.description: Fires when a new outgoing chat is initiated.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new outgoing TimelinesAI WhatsApp chat is initiated, i.e. the connected account starts a conversation with a contact. Represents the start of an outbound conversation, carrying the chat and WhatsApp account details.

newIncomingChat.name: newIncomingChat
newIncomingChat.description: Fires when a new incoming chat (i.e. from a user) is created.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new incoming TimelinesAI WhatsApp chat is created, i.e. a contact starts a conversation with the connected account. Represents the start of an inbound conversation, carrying the chat and WhatsApp account details.

newSentMessage.name: newSentMessage
newSentMessage.description: Fires when a message is sent (outgoing).

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an outgoing WhatsApp message is sent from TimelinesAI. Represents a single outbound message with its text, sender/recipient, any attachments, and the parent chat context.

message.text: Sending some example document to you

newReceivedMessage.name: newReceivedMessage
newReceivedMessage.description: Fires when a message is received (incoming).

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an incoming WhatsApp message is received in TimelinesAI. Represents a single inbound message with its text, sender/recipient, any attachments, and the parent chat context.

message.text: Sending some example document to you

newUploadedFile.name: newUploadedFile
newUploadedFile.description: Fires when a new file is uploaded in a chat.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new file is uploaded to TimelinesAI. Polls the uploaded-files list and emits each newly added file as it appears.

newWhatsappAccount.name: newWhatsappAccount
newWhatsappAccount.description: Fires when a new WhatsApp account is added/registered.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a WhatsApp account is connected to TimelinesAI. Represents a newly registered/connected account, carrying its id, phone number, status, and owner details.
